model.name: Open Claude.ai RC action (per-pane deep link to the pane's agent)
model.description: An action, visible and fireable from a pane's surface, that opens the Claude app (or the web page as fallback) at the SELECTED pane's AGENT's Remote Control — resolving the pane -> its agent -> its session id -> a per-pane deep link (e.g. claude.ai/code/<session-id>) — so firing it on pane 0.1 opens 0.1's agent's RC, never another pane's.
model.tronQuote: an action that opens the Claude app or webpage at the AGENT's RC for the SELECTED pane (per-pane deep link, e.g. claude.ai/code/<session-id>)

acceptanceCriteria.text: The action is visible AND fireable from the pane surface (the pane's own action affordance).
Firing resolves the SELECTED pane -> its agent -> its session id -> the RC deep link (claude.ai/code/<session-id>).
Opens the Claude app if available, else the web page (app-if-available-else-web).
Opens the RIGHT agent's RC: firing on pane 0.1 must NOT open 0.0's RC (per-pane isolation, no cross-pane leak).
Verified @390 mobile REAL-WebKit: the action fires and opens the correct per-pane deep link.
